headline: Amazon Bedrock adds Kimi K3 with cross-region availability and prompt caching
summary: AWS announced general availability of Moonshot AI’s Kimi K3 on Amazon Bedrock on 18 September 2026. AWS says it is available in all AWS Regions where Bedrock is offered through cross-Region inference, and describes Kimi K3 as the first open-weight model on Bedrock with explicit prompt caching. AWS attributes to Moonshot AI the claims that Kimi K3 has 2.8 trillion parameters, native vision, a 1-million-token context window and about 2.5x better scaling efficiency than Kimi K2. The service launch is documented by AWS; model specifications and comparative efficiency remain vendor-reported, and no independent capability or cost test was conducted here.
